comments:
Item kept at the Cultural Palace of Nationalities in Beijing (CPN). The CPN catalogue number is given as 4780(2) in [V4DZTVU8]: 305 and as 2468(2) in [5IPSARNF]: xci-xcii and [CTQMVBPR]: 27.

In view of the signature, originally part of the 'Bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang collection. [8H6M69W4] does not list any item with the signature "phyi zha 30."

item_description:
No title visible on the cover page.
The title in the incipit was originally written in color and appears faded in the black and white  reproduction.
Missing folios: 13-18 (in the middle of the chapter on direct perception).
Annotation on the cover page: 2(89).
Lines/folio: 8.
Change of script style in the later half of the text.
Standard conjuncts and abbreviations.
Numerals either written out in full with letters or as a number; used for phonetic value (i.e., 4n for bzhin).
Retroflex n for med.
See [CTQMVBPR]: 36-39.

Contains glosses that name the individuals referred to as "kha cig"/"kha cig na re" ([5IPSARNF]: lcii). Mentioned are for instance (with their tentative identification): sa (ID:3892), rngog (ID:3786), phya (ID:3831), dan (ID:3840), rtsang (ID:3839), 'jam gsar (ID:3884), skyal (ID:4020), khro po (for Khro phu? (ID:3878)), khyung (ID:3809), ye 'bar (according to Schwabland (ID:3825), more likely (ID:4264)), nag (maybe another way of referring to gTsang nag pa or sKyel nag, or reference to (ID:6340)?).
